thread:
Aisha Khan: FYI vendor bulk import just sent ~120 candidates with incorrect timezone and inverted phone_opt_in column. Getting a few privacy flags.
Noah Park: Which fields exactly?
Aisha Khan: time_zone column is mostly Europe/London but should be America/Los_Angeles for this vendor. phone_opt_in uses Y/N where our importer expects 1/0.
Maya Rodriguez: That will schedule interviews at the wrong local time and opt people into SMS. Need quick mitigation.
Noah Park: Is this the nightly bulk job id=2026-04-01-02:50?
Aisha Khan: Yes. Sample CSV row: ```email,first_name,time_zone,phone_opt_in
sam@example.com,Sam,Europe/London,Y
```
Samir Patel: Our importer treats phone_opt_in as integer; Y got coerced to 1 so they were opted in. Quick plan: 1) Pause scheduler + SMS queue. 2) Backfill correct time_zone where vendor=solstice. 3) Normalize phone_opt_in mapping. 4) Notify affected candidates and vendor.
Recruiting Bot: :warning: 123 rows processed in job 2026-04-01-02:50. SMS queue deliveries: 12.
Noah Park: Pausing SMS queue and scheduled interview dispatch now.
Samir Patel: I'll push a hotfix to importer: when vendor='solstice', map time_zone -> vendor_timezone_map, and map phone_opt_in = (value in ['1','true','Y']). Adding CI validation for allowed timezones.
Aisha Khan: Can you produce list of impacted candidate ids so Comms can approve messaging?
Samir Patel: Running query: SELECT id,email,time_zone,phone_opt_in FROM candidates WHERE source_vendor='solstice' AND created_at>='2026-04-01'; (est 123 rows)
Maya Rodriguez: Draft comms in #people-ops-drafts: "Hi X — we scheduled an event with the wrong time zone or SMS settings. We've fixed the issue and you can opt-out here: [link]. Sorry for the confusion." Sending after legal review.
Noah Park: Snapshot of scheduler taken. Will re-run corrected import in staging then prod.
Samir Patel: Dry-run shows 123/123 time_zones normalized and phone_opt_in normalized. Preparing prod patch after approvals.
Aisha Khan: Vendor acknowledged they sent Y/N instead of 1/0 and will patch their feed. Adding vendor schema contract to onboarding checklist.
Maya Rodriguez: Logging incident for monthly recruiting ops review and preparing a one-paragraph RCA.
Noah Park: Assigning tasks: Samir - importer patch + tests; Noah - pause/verify queues + re-run; Maya - comms draft; Aisha - vendor escalation. Blocking until vendor confirms corrected feed. :thumbsup:
